note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. This form is the family's gold template, so the second persona intentionally exercises the one severity path not yet covered by other *-test-result batches this backlog: an incidental-finding-only result grades 'minor' (not 'none' or 'moderate'), since `hasOnlyIncidentalFinding` requires incidentalFinding true AND no other abnormal structured finding.

personas.name: normal-ct-chest-complete
personas.description: A normal contrast-enhanced CT chest for chronic cough and weight loss: lungs clear, no acute, mass, infection, or obstructive finding, every mandatory report section present — expect normal classification + none severity + 100% completeness + routine follow-up + no-action.

state.impression: Normal CT chest; no underlying structural lung pathology identified.
state.recommendedFollowUp: No further CT imaging follow-up required for this indication.

personas.name: abnormal-incidental-renal-cyst-minor-complete
personas.description: A CT abdomen/pelvis for non-specific abdominal pain finds no acute pathology to account for the pain, but notes an incidental simple renal cyst: this is the one severity path not yet covered elsewhere in this backlog — an incidental-only finding grades 'minor' (below 'moderate', above 'none'), classified as abnormal (not normal, since an incidental finding is still a positive finding) — report complete — expect abnormal classification + minor severity + 100% completeness + recommended follow-up (per incidental-findings guidance).

state.technique: Contrast-enhanced CT abdomen and pelvis with oral and IV contrast, portal-venous phase.
state.clinicalHistory: Non-specific abdominal pain; CT abdomen/pelvis to investigate.
state.comparisonWithPrevious: No previous abdominal imaging available for comparison.
state.findingsNarrative: No acute intra-abdominal abnormality. A simple 8mm cortical cyst is noted in the right kidney, an incidental finding of no clinical significance. No mass, fracture, infection, or obstruction.
state.impression: No acute abdominal pathology to account for the pain. Incidental simple renal cyst; no further action required.
state.recommendedFollowUp: No specific follow-up required for the incidental renal cyst; manage per usual care.

personas.name: critical-acute-intracranial-haemorrhage-uncommunicated-incomplete
personas.description: An acute intraparenchymal haemorrhage in the right basal ganglia with surrounding oedema and mass effect, phoned through from the on-call radiologist: the haemorrhage auto-escalates classification to critical and follow-up to critical-alert regardless of the other axes; the result has not yet been recorded as communicated, and the clinical history, comparison, and impression sections are not yet completed while the stroke team responds — expect critical classification + major severity + 40% completeness + critical-alert follow-up + urgent-review.
